carousel.nri_angle: NRI investors hold significant positions in Indian IT stocks; the sector's 25% decline represents billions in diaspora wealth erosion. The structural shift affects the economic trajectory of young Indians who viewed software engineering as their path to prosperity.
carousel.author: Diaspora Desk
